voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: The Wash, England. October, twelve sixteen. King John's baggage train set out across the estuary at low tide.
A chronicler wrote that the land opened in the middle of the water, and whirlpools swallowed everything.
Many historians think at least one crown was lost. Days later, the king died.
The marsh was drained for farming long ago. The old estuary is dry land now, miles from the sea.
Some doubt much was lost at all. In twenty twenty-four, a new dig was approved. None of it has ever been found.
